skills.description: Manage the full lifecycle of contacts in the address book: add new contacts with name, phone number, and relationship, search for existing contacts, modify contact fields, remove contacts by person_id, and verify state after each operation.
Search and retrieve contact information by name, phone number, or relationship. Cross-reference contacts with message history to verify communication records. Pure retrieval — no state changes.

Send messages to contacts via phone number with full prerequisite checking: verify cellular service is on, enable it if needed, look up recipient phone number from contacts, send the message, and verify it appears in sent message history.

Search and audit the complete message history: retrieve messages by phone number, search by content keywords, cross-reference with contacts, and compile communication audit reports. Pure retrieval — no state changes.

Create reminders for future events with precise timestamp computation: get current time, compute future timestamps using shift or datetime-to-timestamp conversion, verify computed times are correct, schedule reminders, and confirm they appear in the reminder list.

Manage the full lifecycle of reminders: create multiple reminders, search and filter the reminder list, modify reminder content or scheduled time, remove completed or obsolete reminders, and verify the final reminder state after each operation.

Manage device radio connectivity — cellular service and wifi. Check current status, toggle radios on/off, verify state changes, and understand connectivity prerequisites for messaging and other operations.

Manage device power state (low battery mode) and location services. Toggle low battery mode, enable/disable location services, query current device location, and handle the cascade effect where low battery mode blocks all other settings changes.

Perform precise timestamp and unit conversion computations: get current Unix timestamp, convert between timestamps and datetime components, shift timestamps forward/backward, compute time differences, format durations, and convert between measurement units. Pure retrieval — no state changes.

Execute complex multi-domain workflows spanning contacts, messaging, reminders, device settings, and time utilities. Typical patterns: find contact → check cellular → send message → schedule follow-up reminder; or audit all state → make changes in each domain → re-audit and report differences.
